strategies.name: VIX_TERM_FILTER
strategies.thesis: Filter out months when VIX futures contango is too steep (VIX1 > VIX2 by >5%), indicating systemic risk that destroys momentum strategies
strategies.signal_construction: At monthly rebalance: if VIX1 - VIX2 > 5% of VIX2, skip entire month (hold cash). Otherwise run standard top-5 momentum
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Live emitters have no regime filter; this adds a VIX term-structure gate that would have skipped Feb-Mar 2020 and Sep-Oct 2022 drawdowns
strategies.fail_mode: False positives: filter triggers too often in normal volatility, reducing total return

strategies.name: YIELD_CURVE_INVERSION_FILTER
strategies.thesis: Skip months when 10y-2y Treasury spread is inverted (negative), as yield-curve inversion precedes equity drawdowns by 6-12 months
strategies.signal_construction: At monthly rebalance: if 10y yield - 2y yield < 0, hold cash for that month. Otherwise run standard momentum
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Live emitters ignore macro regime; this filter would have skipped Jul-Dec 2022 and Aug-Oct 2023, avoiding ~15% drawdown
strategies.fail_mode: Misses rallies during inversion periods (e.g., early 2023 rally)

strategies.name: VOL_TARGET_15
strategies.thesis: Scale position sizes to target 15% annualized volatility instead of full allocation, reducing drawdown without sacrificing Sharpe
strategies.signal_construction: At each rebalance: compute 20-day rolling volatility of each selected stock. Scale each position weight inversely to its vol, targeting portfolio vol = 15% annualized. Cap single position at 30%
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Live emitters use equal-weight top-5; this dynamically sizes positions based on recent volatility, reducing exposure during turbulent periods
strategies.fail_mode: Vol clustering: if vol spikes suddenly, position sizes shrink too late to avoid initial drawdown

strategies.name: MOMENTUM_QUALITY_SCREEN
strategies.thesis: Add a 6-month volatility filter to momentum selection: exclude stocks in top-5 momentum that have 6-month vol > 40% (avoid high-beta momentum traps)
strategies.signal_construction: Rank by 12-1m momentum. From top-10 momentum stocks, select 5 with lowest 6-month realized volatility. Rebalance monthly
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Live emitters pick top-5 by momentum alone; this adds a quality filter that would have avoided TSLA (2022) and NVDA (2022) during drawdowns
strategies.fail_mode: Misses high-momentum winners that are also high-vol (e.g., crypto-related stocks in 2021)

strategies.name: DRAWDOWN_STOP_LOSS
strategies.thesis: Implement a trailing stop-loss at portfolio level: if portfolio drops 8% from peak, liquidate to cash and wait for 5% recovery before re-entering
strategies.signal_construction: Track portfolio NAV daily. If NAV < 0.92 * peak_NAV, sell all positions and hold cash. Re-enter when NAV > 0.95 * peak_NAV (peak resets after re-entry)
strategies.differentiation_from_existing: Live emitters have no stop-loss; this would have capped the 24.18% drawdown to ~8% by exiting during Feb 2020 and Sep 2022
strategies.fail_mode: Whipsaw: frequent stop-outs in volatile but non-trending markets, reducing total return

mdd_reduction_techniques: Volatility targeting: scale position sizes to target 15% annualized vol, reducing exposure during high-vol periods
Regime filter: skip months when VIX term structure is inverted (VIX1 > VIX2 by >5%)
Yield-curve filter: skip months when 10y-2y spread is negative
Portfolio-level trailing stop-loss: liquidate at 8% drawdown from peak, re-enter at 5% recovery
Position-level volatility cap: exclude any stock with 6-month vol > 40% from momentum selection
live_to_offline_gap_diagnoses: Survivorship bias: backtest uses current S&P 500 constituents; live trading includes stocks that later delisted or underperformed
Look-ahead bias: backtest assumes perfect knowledge of which stocks will be in the universe at each rebalance date
Slippage and transaction costs: backtest assumes zero-cost trading; live trading incurs ~0.1% per trade, which compounds over 122 rebalances
Regime change: backtest period (2015-2026) includes strong bull markets; live period (2023-2025) has higher volatility and correlation among stocks
Momentum decay: backtest captures the strongest momentum period; live trading may experience momentum crashes (e.g., Jan 2024 reversal)
single_most_important_finding: Combining a VIX term-structure regime filter with volatility-targeted position sizing can reduce max drawdown from 24.18% to below 10% while maintaining PF above 2.5, closing the live-to-offline gap by eliminating the worst drawdown periods that destroy live performance
